notes_for_human: All salesforce.com and careers.salesforce.com (tier 1) pages returned 403 Forbidden on direct fetch — likely bot/Cloudflare blocking, not a content issue. Could not verify Summer 2027 internship (general Futureforce, non-Tech-Launchpad) eligibility, sponsorship, or opening-date language from any tier 1 or tier 2 source within the 8-call budget; WebSearch surfaced snippets from aggregators (Built In, getsmartresume.com) claiming a 'projected graduation date of December 2027 or later' eligibility line and a 'May 31' deadline, but per the task rules these are tier 3 and were excluded from quotes/fields entirely — treat that specific eligibility and deadline claim as unconfirmed. The Tech Launchpad data captured reflects the 2026 cohort (already in progress as of 2026-07-29); the 2027-cycle application window for Tech Launchpad had not yet been posted on the CodePath page at check time. A follow-up check of the CodePath page and a retry of salesforce.com via a tool that can render JS or bypass bot detection (e.g. a headless-browser tool) around or after October 2026 would be needed to get verbatim 2027-cycle opening dates and sponsorship language. Browser pass 2026-07-29: the Futureforce hub (salesforce.com/company/careers/university-recruiting/, 403 to plain fetch) renders in a real browser and contains NO eligibility, class-year, sponsorship, or Tech Launchpad language — hub-level silence, tier 1.
